documents.title: Buyer’s website brief
documents.text:
Website brief
Buyer: Nia Wekesa
Business: Kijani Loom Studio

I need a small website for my woven homewares business. The agreed deliverable is a five-page website with a contact form. The pages should cover our story, products, custom orders, delivery information and contact details. I will provide the photographs and product descriptions; the seller will arrange them and make the pages usable on mobile devices.

Please build the site in English and hand over the completed files and editing instructions. We agreed on a fixed project price of USD 600. The intended handover date is 20 September 2025. Hosting fees and any future changes after handover are outside this brief.
